acceptance_criteria.abstentions: retain every row in denominator; an abstention is a missed detection for sensitivity, not a false positive for FPR; report abstention rate and exact two-sided 95% CI separately; no exclusion
acceptance_criteria.acceptance: candidate passes only if every positive stratum x shot sensitivity one-sided exact 95% lower Clopper-Pearson bound meets its registered minimum and every control scenario x shot FPR one-sided exact 95% upper bound is <= 0.05

baselines.fixed_tvd: unchanged threshold=0.05 and existing max(0.05,1/sqrt(shots)) guard
baselines.permutation: unchanged pooled-label TVD permutation p-value, 999 resamples, add-one correction, alpha=0.05

candidate_rule.definition: Flag iff observed TVD is strictly greater than the shot-specific cutoff; cutoff is max of the two negative-control higher empirical 95th percentiles on calibration data.
candidate_rule.name: calibration-control higher-quantile TVD cutoff

disjointness_check.basis: Compared the proposed IDs, template seeds, sampling seeds, and generated reference fingerprints against all 3,600 valid saved per-configuration outputs (240 prior templates, 3,600 prior sampling seeds). Zero overlaps.

evaluation_split.name: new_heldout_20261014
evaluation_split.paired_templates: Reuse each new reference template across all 5 scenarios and all 3 shot counts; methods are calculated from the same sampled count pairs.

execution_safeguards.manifest: Unique run directory, single manifest writer, per-output create-only writes; no concurrent resume or sync client in staging during execution.
execution_safeguards.prior_error: The prior RuntimeError: can't allocate lock has no captured traceback or system-resource telemetry in the saved run artifacts. The inspected runner performs sequential work and does not create worker locks. Root cause therefore remains undetermined; single-process execution and local staging reduce likely process-lock and OneDrive contention but do not prove the cause.
execution_safeguards.staging: Run from local non-OneDrive NTFS staging directory C:/Quantum_Simulator_runs/...; do not stream per-configuration manifest replacements through OneDrive. Copy the finalized, checksummed run directory into a new reports/experiments folder once after completion.

failure_modes_addressed: excessive TVD false positives on negative controls at 256 and 1024 shots from the fixed 0.05 / 1/sqrt(shots) cutoff
sensitivity and false-positive trade-off for the existing pooled-label permutation detector
global_claim: Candidate passes only if every component sensitivity and FPR criterion passes. The conjunction uses per-cell one-sided alpha=0.05 intersection-union testing; no multiplicity correction is applied to the all-conditions-must-pass gate. All three methods are scored on exactly the same held-out configurations; no thresholds or criteria are selected after opening held-out outputs.
hypothesis: A calibration-only, shot-conditioned TVD cutoff selected from negative-control empirical nulls will reduce low-shot false-positive rates relative to unchanged fixed-guard TVD while meeting the registered sensitivity floors; the permutation detector is a comparator expected to retain lower control FPR but may lose subtle-fault sensitivity at lower shots.
methodological_decision_for_owner: The calibration-only candidate was evaluated descriptively on the previously inspected validation data: subtle sensitivity was 13/120 at 256 shots and 41/120 at 1024, below the unchanged registered minima. Decide whether to proceed with the new held-out run as a confirmatory falsification/resource-cost study, or pause and define a new candidate using calibration data only before starting a fresh preregistration. No held-out simulation has been run.

metrics.abstention_handling: No row is excluded. Abstentions count as non-detections (false negatives) for sensitivity, do not count as positive flags for FPR, and are reported separately with exact intervals.

intervals.paired_differences: Two-sided 95% paired template bootstrap percentile interval, 10,000 resamples; within each cell, resample the same template indices jointly across all methods; deterministic bootstrap seed 90261014.

metrics.primary: Sensitivity for each fault strength x shot cell; FPR separately for each negative-control scenario x shot cell.
secondary: abstention rate by scenario x shot
precision under the fixed 60% positive design mix (descriptive only)
paired detector risk differences by template and cell

title: Preregistered held-out evaluation of a shot-aware TVD detector

workload.memory_estimate: <1 MiB transient permutation working set for one 8,192-entry pooled count vector and temporaries; 100-300 MB estimated Python working set if all 9,000 result objects are retained. Budget at least 1 GiB available RAM; stream results where possible.

runtime_estimate.basis: Completed 3,600-config calibration took 3,192.3 s (53.2 min); linear projection is ~133 min. Existing pre-run pilot-based estimate was higher than actual calibration time; use a broad 2.25-6 h planning window due circuit depth, host load, permutation work, and Windows filesystem variation.

workload.saved_output_size_estimate: 20.4 MB based on 2,267-byte mean saved calibration result (9,000 records); allow 50 MB for logs and metadata
